notablePrerequisites: There have been a number of permanents sacrificed this turn equal to five plus The Balrog's commander tax.
description:
Cast The Balrog from the command zone by paying {B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Balrog, adding {B}.
Choose to return The Balrog to the command zone from your graveyard.
When The Balrog dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Balrog trigger, destroying any artifact and/or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {R}.
Repeat.
